description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit donation records with the acknowledgment and ledger records they answer to: the organization with its reference, name, the moment the records are read at, the days within which its own policy says a gift is acknowledged and its currency; each gift with its id, reference, donor as the record writes the name, any donor reference, the moment received, the amount, the currency, how it was given (cash, check, card, transfer, securities, in kind or another way) and any note on how an in-kind gift was valued; each donor acknowledgment with its id, the gift it answers, the moment sent and the amount it states; each ledger posting with its id, the gift, the moment posted and the amount posted. The signed report gives the organization and the gifts, each gift past the acknowledgment window against a donor acknowledgment sent, each acknowledgment amount against the gift record, each pair of gifts of one amount on one day for one donor against the spellings the records give, and each in-kind gift against a valuation note, and counts them, and names divergent donation records: a gift recorded with no donor acknowledgment sent, an acknowledgment amount that does not match the gift record, a gift recorded twice under different donor spellings, and an in-kind gift recorded with no valuation note; then an acknowledgment naming a gift the donation records do not hold and a gift whose ledger postings add to another amount than the gift record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A gift inside the acknowledgment window waits; no gifts, no ledger postings, or a gift with no amount leaves those points unverified. Gifts, acknowledgments and postings match by letters and digits, donors without case, accents, punctuation, honorifics or word order with an initial standing for the name it begins, or by donor reference where both carry one, and amounts compare to the cent. This reads whether each gift is acknowledged, acknowledged at its amount, recorded once and valued where given in kind. Verdict nonprofit_donation_divergent, nonprofit_donation_partial, nonprofit_donation_unverified or nonprofit_donation_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-donation-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
